integrity: The delivered standalone finite enumerator verifies all 63 cyclic subgroups at all six critical integer thresholds and the signed integral reflection persistence map. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the graph-metric Vietoris–Rips filtration of the dodecahedral graph and nontrivial cyclic subgroups; no noncyclic subgroup data or Borel cohomology. Published ordinary homotopy types are antecedents; potential unindexed equivariant priority overlap remains.
title: Cyclic-subgroup fixed persistence of dodecahedral Rips complexes
